$comment: The operator-local agent surface commitwork installs and toggles: PreToolUse/Stop hooks, MCP servers and launch programs. This is a DECLARATION; bin/agent-surface.mjs is the only writer and applying stays a human act. Never fleet or deployment surfaces.

guard-destructive.why: the only pre-action gate on force-push, ledger truncation, credential reads and outbound POST

commitwork.why: commitwork's own MCP server: bundled manifests only, credential-stripped scanner env

spine.why: the task spine every session opens against

style.why: the held style corpus /review and /write resolve against

veld.why: the memory backend; disable is registration-only, stop is a separate verb
